subject: Plotting confidence intervals from sampled posterior

messages.author: befc31f30774e5bc
messages.subject: Plotting confidence intervals from sampled posterior
parts:
Hi All,
I've got another question. I've done this before, but for some reason, I cannot get the lines to show up this time. Here is my code.

#FIRST THE MODEL
CDRa4c<-mle2(roundDens~dgampois(mu=exp(a+q2mi*Q2_AvgTMin+s*Species_D), scale=sc), data=CD_Rep, start=list(a=log(mean(CD_Rep$roundDens)), sc=1, q2mi=0,  s=0))

#COMPUTING THE POSTERIOR

p_CD_Rep<-sample.naive.posterior(CDRa4c, n=10000, nobs=nrow(CD_Rep))
colnames(p_CD_Rep)<-c("a", "q2mi", "s")

#PLOTTING
par(mfrow=c(1,1))
plot(AvgDens~Year, data=CD_Rep, type="n", xaxp=c(2010,2012,2), main="Clarkia Reproduction")

points(AvgDens~Year, data=CD_Rep_cg, col="grey10")
points(AvgDens~Year, data=CD_Rep_cp, col="grey60")

#CREATING THE MEAN AND CI LINES BASED ON THE ABOVE POSTERIOR

Tmin.seq<-seq(from=7.33, to=8.82, by=0.01)

mu.CG <- sapply( Tmin.seq , function(z)

mean(exp(p_CD_Rep$a+p_CD_Rep$q2mi*z+p_CD_Rep$s*0) ))

mu.CP <- sapply( Tmin.seq , function(z)

mean(exp(p_CD_Rep$a+p_CD_Rep$q2mi*z+p_CD_Rep$s*1) ))

mu.ci.CG <- sapply( Tmin.seq , function(z)

PCI(exp(p_CD_Rep$a+p_CD_Rep$q2mi*z+p_CD_Rep$s*0) ))

mu.ci.CP <- sapply( Tmin.seq , function(z)

PCI(exp(p_CD_Rep$a+p_CD_Rep$q2mi*z+p_CD_Rep$s*1) ))


#####  And below is where I'm having trouble

lines(Tmin.seq, mu.CG, lwd=3, col="grey10")
lines(Tmin.seq, mu.CP, lwd=3, col="grey60")
lines(Tmin.seq, mu.ci.CG[1,], lty=2, col="grey10")
lines(Tmin.seq, mu.ci.CG[2,], lty=2, col="grey10")
lines(Tmin.seq, mu.ci.CP[1,], lty=2, col="grey60")
lines(Tmin.seq, mu.ci.CP[2,], lty=2, col="grey60")


Any ideas?


Iara

--
Iara Lacher
MESM - Bren School for Environmental Science and Management
PhD Candidate- UC Davis Ecology Graduate Group

messages.author: 8c8f0ca54c4a2459
messages.subject: Re: Plotting confidence intervals from sampled posterior
parts:
Hi Iara,

Are you getting error messages when executing the lines() commands? If not, my first guess is that your various mu.* variables aren't the values you are expecting. Maybe you can diagnose the problem by running summary() on them.

Noam
